summary: Verified electron installation structure across the project. Key findings: (1) Electron is ONLY installed in root node_modules, NOT in apps/frontend/node_modules. (2) This is CORRECT behavior due to npm workspace hoisting - dependencies are automatically lifted to root to prevent duplicates. (3) Electron resolves correctly: require('electron') returns 'c:\Projects\Auto-Claude-Marketing\node_modules\electron\dist\electron.exe'. (4) The root package.json has workspaces: ['apps/*', 'libs/*'] which causes npm to hoist dependencies to root level. (5) No .npmrc files exist that would affect hoisting behavior. (6) Frontend package.json lists electron as devDependency, but npm workspace installs it at root for efficiency. This is the standard and expected behavior for npm workspaces.
current_status: Electron installation is correct and working as expected. The hoisting to root node_modules is intentional npm workspace behavior, not a bug.
next_steps: Document the workspace hoisting behavior for future reference
Consider adding .npmrc with hoist=false if hoisting causes issues (unlikely needed)
